meta.title: Request Best Offer from all vendors during Evaluation
gaps: Verify that every vendor received the system notification and email.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every vendor received the system notification and email.

steps.note: Open an existing event whose technical stage has closed and is ready for evaluation.
Open the RFQ Settings action for requesting best offers.

args.goal: in the Request for Best Offer panel, enter a valid best-offer submission duration, invite all vendors, click Send Request, and stop when the event shows the Best Offer Requested tag and each vendor row or bid card shows the same status

steps.note: Complete the request flow and inspect the event and vendor-row status that the catalog has no dedicated domain step for.
Assert that the request status is visible after sending.

args.need: verify in each vendor's notification or email inbox that the Best Offer request was received

steps.note: Email and per-vendor notification delivery require access to external vendor inboxes that the catalog cannot inspect.
Keep a final assertion for the event status after the external delivery check.
